hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */src/*.ts|*/src/*.tsx|*/src/*.css) pnpm exec prettier --write "$f" >/dev/null;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true

git status --porcelain -- src src-tauri/src | grep -q . || exit 0; out=$(pnpm typecheck 2>&1) || { printf 'Stop gate: typecheck failing:
%s
' "$out" | tail -30 >&2; exit 2; }; out=$(pnpm vitest run 2>&1) || { printf 'Stop gate: tests failing:
%s
' "$out" | tail -30 >&2; exit 2; }
